name: cobol-cli
title: COBOL CLI
blurb: COBOL CLI on GNUCOBOL: byte-exact counting over a sequential file, hand-rolled argv parser, a COBOL unit driver plus a shell suite, I/O in one program

verify.name: usage-error
verify.cmd: set +e; ./bin/{{ npm_name }} --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; status=$?; echo "exit status: $status"; test "$status" -eq 2

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd: set +e; ./bin/{{ npm_name }} nope.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; status=$?; echo "exit status: $status"; test "$status" -eq 1

verify.name: stdin
verify.cmd:
set +e; piped=$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }} -w); status=$?; echo "stdin exit status: $status, output: $piped"; dash=$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }} -w -); dash_status=$?; echo "dash exit status: $dash_status, output: $dash"; test "$status" -eq 0 && test "$piped" = '3' && test "$dash_status" -eq 0 && test "$dash" = '3 -'

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd:
set -eu; mkdir -p .parity; printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' > .parity/p1.txt; printf 'one line, no trailing newline' > .parity/p2.txt; printf 'h\303\251llo w\303\266rld
' > .parity/p3.txt; : > .parity/p4.txt; printf 'alpha\vbeta gammadelta
' > .parity/p5.txt; for f in .parity/p*.txt; do ours=$(./bin/{{ npm_name }} "$f"); theirs=$(wc -l -w -c "$f"); echo "$f: $ours"; test "$ours" = "$theirs"; done
